_comment.1: OPEN-LOOP capture for contrib/com_survey: one minute of raw ROI frames, same camera configuration as steering_par_fsp_wfs_com.json, with NO tracker, NO fsp and NO DAC in the pipeline. Nothing is actuated, so whatever the beam does here is the beam, not a loop.
_comment.2: Run it with the FSM parked at its normal bias, exactly as contrib/probe_frame.json expects. Let the coarse channels settle (~30 s) before starting, or the drift during settling will show up as beam motion.
_comment.3: Writes com_survey.aylp: 40-byte header per frame (magic u32, version/status/type/units u8 at 4..7, log_dim.y/x u64 at 8/16, pitch.y/x double at 24/32), then height*width uint8. At 248x248 and fs~381 one minute is ~22.9k frames and ~1.4 GB. Check you have the disk space.
_comment.4: count = 60 s * 381 fps = 22860. 381 Hz is the MEASURED rate at this 248x248 ROI (2026-08-04), not the 3788 Hz of the old 32x32 ROI -- a 10x drop, so the old count of 227280 would have run for 10 minutes and written 14 GB. Re-measure and rescale if the ROI changes; the analyser reads the real frame count from the file and only needs --fs to convert to Hz.
_comment.5: Then: ./build/com_survey com_survey.aylp --fs 381   (add --row-time once you have measured it; it does not affect the recommendation).
_comment.6: MEASURED 2026-08-05 from a 57.6 s capture at this ROI: fs 397-398 Hz (NOT 3788 -- that was the old 32x32), background 3.21 counts sigma 0.40, beam amplitude 251.6, beam sigma 15.83 px / FWHM 37.27 px, saturation 0.02% over the whole record.
_comment.7: THE SOURCE IS CHOPPED at 4.411 Hz (autocorrelation lag 90 frames = 226.7 ms, r 0.69) with ~12% duty at half maximum -- ON 27.7 ms, OFF 186.4 ms, dark/bright flux 2202/208869 counts = 100:1. Verified NOT an alias: the same 8.79/13.38/17.57 Hz harmonics appear at fs 397, 653 and 990 Hz, and an alias would move with the sample rate. CONSEQUENCE: ~90% of frames in a raw capture are dark, which makes both trackers look broken (fit_com 79% rejected, wfs_com 97%) and makes the residual look 'boiling' when it is only dark-frame noise. Analyse the illuminated frames only, or capture CW.

params._roi: 248x248 for this survey, not the 160x160 the loop configs run at: the survey is where the beam's SHAPE is being characterised, and fit_com's gaussian fit and wfs_com's template both want the wings inside the frame rather than clipped by the ROI edge. Centred on the 2026-08-04 find_roi probe, full-sensor beam (1064, 536), so start = 1064-124 / 536-124.

pipeline._comment: Live view while it captures; decimated so it cannot back-pressure the loop.
